This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 02/22/2026 (the "Effective
Date") by and between Summit Medical Devices Inc, with its registered office at 1200 Industrial
Parkway, Denver ("Party A"), and Crestview Supplies LLC, with its registered office at 88 Commerce
Drive, Denver ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 36 months from the Effective Date unless
terminated earlier in accordance with Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall
use it solely for the purposes of this Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales.
